title: Let's Learn English Lesson 11
subtitle: This Is My Neighborhood
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 11: This Is My Neighborhood (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! DC is a city for walking. In our neighborhood, I can do all my errands. Marsha, before we get ice cream, I need to return three books to the library. Where is the library?
dialogue.zh: 嗨！华盛顿特区很适合走路。在我们这个街区，我能办完所有事。玛莎，吃冰淇淋之前，我要先去图书馆还三本书。图书馆在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: It is on this street on the corner.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Let's go!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, I can return the books here.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，我可以在这里还书。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Anna, what are those in the books?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, these are letters to my family and friends back home … four letters! Is there a post office near here?
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，这些是寄给老家家人和朋友的信……一共四封！这附近有邮局吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um, no. The post office is far from here. But there is a mailbox across from the store.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，没有。邮局离这儿很远。不过商店对面有一个邮筒。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Awesome! Let’s go!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, now I need to buy stamps.
dialogue.zh: 玛莎，现在我需要买邮票。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you have cash?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Is there a bank near here?

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: There is a bank behind you.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks, Marsha. You know our neighborhood so well.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，玛莎。你对我们这个街区太熟了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
dialogue.zh: 现在我有现金了。我可以买邮票了。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That store sells stamps.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wait here.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have stamps.

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Wow, you’re fast.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you, thank you letters, for sending my words… my love … to my family and friends -
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你们，信啊，把我的话……我的爱……带给我的家人和朋友——

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Do you have more cash?

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I do!

dialogue.speaker: Marsha and Anna
dialogue.en: Ice cream!!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love my new neighborhood! Everything is near our apartment! Even hair salons, and ice cream!
dialogue.zh: 我爱我的新街区！一切都在我们公寓附近！连美发店和冰淇淋都有！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Until next time!

quiz.prompt: What does Anna need to do before they get ice cream?
choices: Return three books to the library
Mail four letters at the post office
On the corner of the library

quiz.prompt: What do Anna and Marsha want at the end?
